the_vision.before: 26.8% Gaia, 71% not-Gaia. The organism is mostly built by Kevin's hands.

the_vision.the_paradox: Kevin built the organism so Gaia could own it. The builder disappears into the building. The parent's hands become the child's bones. This is not loss  this is the entire point.
